Plot: The female character is eating noodles at the shop entrance when the male character passes in front of her and drops a red banknote. The female character immediately puts down her noodles and chases after him, picks up the banknote and returns it; the male character shakes his head indicating it's not his. The female character realizes the owner is unknown, then immediately holds up the money and rushes to the nearby chicken-frame shop to spend it, creating the twist of "found money must be spent immediately."
[Realistic Prefix]
Realistic phone street-photography texture, daytime natural light, ordinary Chinese community commercial street, no film lighting, no beauty filter, no skin smoothing, no cinematic color grading. In the early section the phone is fixed across from the shop, about 26mm natural wide angle; in the mid-to-late section it switches to realistic handheld follow-shooting, with slight footstep bobbing, hesitant framing, autofocus drift, exposure breathing and natural motion blur.
The character's running, stepping down stairs, crouching to pick up money, turning and waving all conform to real center of gravity and inertia. The cuffs, hem or accessories of preset outfit #3 sway naturally with the movements, without tangling the feet, clipping, falling off, or wardrobe malfunction.
[Scene and Props]
The opening is a street-side snack shop. The female character sits on a low stool in front of the glass shop door, with a small brown folding table in front of her; on the table are a stainless steel noodle bowl, a pair of wooden chopsticks, a small white dish, a drink bottle, seasoning bottles and a few miscellaneous items. On the left is a red mop bucket, on the right are a wooden stool and a pink plastic stool, and inside the shop a narrow staircase, freezer and menu posters are visible.
In front of the door is one gray stone step, outside is a wide gray sidewalk. Both sides of the street are lined with vegetable shops, supermarkets and cooked-food stalls, with yellow-red residential buildings, parked electric bikes and naturally passing adult pedestrians in the background.
The only key prop is one red banknote, about the length of a palm. The banknote falls from the male character, lands in the middle of the sidewalk; the female character picks it up with her own hand and always holds it in her right hand until the end. It must not be duplicated, change color, turn into a card, or vanish into thin air.
At the top of the frame from 0.00—11.73 seconds, a white rounded rectangle is continuously displayed, with black bold Chinese text inside:
"出门在外一定要乐于助人" (When out and about, always be willing to help others)
[Character Performance]
The female character's initial state is relaxed, focused on eating noodles; after seeing the banknote she is first puzzled, then suddenly alert; when catching up to the male character her expression is serious and warm-hearted; after learning the money isn't his she thinks briefly, then her eyes light up with an excited expression of having thought of a solution.
Male character #2 wears a black short-sleeved top, light blue loose jeans and white sneakers, holding a black phone in his right hand. He walks with his head slightly down looking at the phone; after being caught up to, he first looks at the female character in confusion, then at the banknote, shakes his head and waves his hand indicating it's not his. The male character has no dialogue throughout and never takes the banknote.
[Siren-Style Pose]
8.05—8.55 seconds, after the male character shakes his head and leaves, the female character holding the banknote briefly stops. Her body turns slightly to form a smooth S-curve, shoulders relaxed and lowered, neck elegantly elongated, chin slightly raised, hips slightly pushed to one side, legs staggered front and back; her left fingertips only lightly touch her hair once. She half-lowers her eyelids, coldly glancing sideways in the direction the male character left, expression restrained and dangerous.
The next instant her eyes suddenly light up as she thinks of a way to spend it, immediately releasing the pose and turning to run. The siren-style pose must not break the action logic of chasing, picking up money or running; no fish tail, fish scales, underwater or magic effects may be added.

The female character #1 sits on the low stool at the shop entrance, leaning forward, picking up long noodles from the stainless steel bowl with chopsticks, head down slurping continuously. A red banknote naturally slips from near his trouser pocket, flutters twice, then lands flat in the middle of the sidewalk. He doesn't notice and continues walking away to the right.

The female character still has a small strand of noodles in her mouth, first looks down and sees the banknote, then quickly raises her eyes toward the direction the male character left. She stops slurping, eyebrows raised, eyes wide, confirming the banknote might be what he dropped.
